The note is misleading: Ann, Hana, and Ivo don’t have to fill slots 1–3, so Cara needn’t be slot 4. Re-checking the earlier solution, the valid assignment was:

1 Ann  
2 Hana  
3 Ivo  
4 Ben  
5 Cara  
6 Gus  
7 Dev  
8 Finn  
9 Elif

This satisfies all constraints, including Ann–Ivo having exactly one person between them (Hana), Dev–Elif having exactly one between (Finn), and Gus immediately after Cara.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Ann","2":"Hana","3":"Ivo","4":"Ben","5":"Cara","6":"Gus","7":"Dev","8":"Finn","9":"Elif"}
CONFIDENCE: 95
